corrections.reason: The printed glyph in እንደሁነ is clearly the 2nd order ሁ (with the right-side horizontal stroke), preserving the authentic archaic Andemta form.
Both visually on the page and grammatically in Classical Ge'ez (imperfective of ኮነ), the verb is ዘይከውን with 1st-order ከ, not 6th-order ክ.
The printed glyph is clearly 2nd-order ሁ (ሁነች) rather than 7th-order ሆ (ሆነች).
